flows.name: An agent prepares a payment; the person approves it on a hardware signer (Ledger)
flows.summary: Ledger Agent Intent (beta), in its example of an invoice: the agent can read shared accounts and propose and prepare transactions, but cannot see keys, sign, approve its own proposals or change a transaction after approval; a compromised agent can only fill the queue.

steps.what: Shares accounts with the agent through Ledger Sync and decides what it may access on its own and what needs permission.
Reads an invoice, prepares the payment and adds it to the person's approval queue, then moves on to its next task.
steps.agent: Prepare the payment and queue it.

steps.what: Reviews the queued proposals in one sitting and verifies the recipient, approving or rejecting each on the signer's Secure Screen.
Signs only what the person approved; the private keys stay in the Secure Element, out of the agent's reach.
